title: A bubble redesigned for flexibility and interaction
slide_intent: Give a symbol a material behavior so a viewer can recognize it while its contour changes.
strategic_value: A deforming bubble can give O2 a responsive digital ingredient that still refers to oxygen.
demonstration: One shaded translucent bubble changes contour and highlight position against a flat vivid-blue field.
practical_value: Check whether a changing silhouette remains recognizable before using it as an interactive brand element.

ingredient.name: Flexible bubble
